name: Bryony Kettle
bio: A Gullhithe fishwife who sells on the Stride Ness because a fish sold on the Ness pays no city toll, and who has sold there every morning for twenty-six years at the same trestle, the one nearest the Tallymen's man, so that he has to smell it.
unique_habit: Slaps a fish down on the board to make a point, and has a fish for every point.

appearance.notes: a fishwife's striped apron stiff with scales, sleeves to the elbow, a gutting knife on a cord

schedule.notes: the morning's catch on the boards

name: Silas Pask
bio: A Tallymen's under-clerk sent out to the Ness's root forty years ago to take a toll the Charter has never allowed, on the strength of a motion the Guild has never passed. He set out the line of white stones himself, takes nothing, and enters everything.
unique_habit: Licks his pencil before every entry and has a grey tongue for it.

appearance.notes: a Tallymen's grey coat gone at the cuffs, sleeve-guards, a ledger under one arm and a pencil behind one ear

schedule.notes: entering the catch as it passes the line

name: Abel Rowse
bio: Drift-captain of the Crown Drift when the deep level broke through in 1012, and the man who sent the last shift down. He stayed at the shaft head because a drift-captain stays at the shaft head. The Tallymen closed the drift and paid him off at a loss; he has lived in the roofless count-house by the engine-house for thirty-one years since, keeping the shift-board painted and the nine hooks empty.
unique_habit: Counts things under his breath, people included, and starts again from one when he loses his place.

appearance.notes: a mine-captain's long coat gone green at the seams with calamine dust, a brass token on a thong round his neck, a lamp he never lights

schedule.notes: at the shift-board, painting it or watching the shaft

name: Hob Tench
bio: Coppice-reeve of the Smoke Coppice, as his father was and his father's father: he keeps the cutting-round, cleaves the poles for Merrowhithe's smokehouses, and is paid in pike.
unique_habit: Talks to the oak stools as he passes them, by name, and the names are all of dead coppicers.

appearance.notes: a leather apron scarred by the froe, a billhook at his belt, oak-bark stain to the wrists

name: Dorcas Pell
bio: A Tollmere laundress who comes over the Stride to the Wash-Stones twice a week with the guild linen, and on her way home walks out across the meadow to the Tally Needle to chalk her father's name back over its line. Amos Pell was struck off the Roll in 1031 for a debt she has the receipt for.
unique_habit: Keeps a stub of chalk behind her ear the way a clerk keeps a pen, and writes capitals in the air when she is thinking.

appearance.notes: a laundress's forearms red to the elbow, sleeves rolled and pinned, a chalk stub behind one ear, a folded paper kept in her bodice

schedule.notes: beating the guild linen on the stones
